name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
setup: Lie on your side on a mat, a towel under the top elbow, a light dumbbell in the top hand.
cues: Turn the dumbbell up toward the ceiling, elbow pinned on the towel.
Turn the handle out toward the wall like a gate swinging open.
Keep the towel pinned in place the whole rep.

faults.fault: Towel dropping as the elbow drifts
faults.fix: Keep the towel in place; the hand travels, the elbow stays.

faults.fault: Twisting the trunk to turn further
faults.fix: Face the wall ahead and stop the handle where the turn ends.
